figures.finding: American Samoa follows US federal labour law: the Fair Labor Standards Act applies there, with industry-specific minimum wages instead of the federal one; film and television production is not one of the defined industries, so an employer in it falls under 'Miscellaneous Activities', USD 5.80 an hour from 30 September 2024 (next USD 0.40 step due 30 September 2027), with overtime premium past 40 hours a week. No screen-specific agreement or rate was found.

value.law: Fair Labor Standards Act; Fair Minimum Wage Act of 2007 as amended by Public Law 114-61

figures.applies: American Samoa, all employees of employers outside the defined industries, from 30 September 2024.

sources.said: generally to employment within American Samoa as it does to employment within the United States. … The Fair Minimum Wage Act of 2007, as most recently amended by H.R. 2617 (Public Law 114-61), sets industry-specific minimum wage rates within American Samoa and provides that additional increases in those minimum wage rates of $0.40 per hour will occur every three years on September 30 … scheduled to increase again in 2021, 2024, 2027, etc. … American Samoa's minimum wage rates are set for particular industries, not for an employee's particular occupation. … including the payment of premium rates to certain covered employees who work more than 40 hours in a workweek

figures.finding: American Samoa's 2020 census found 96.7% of household residents aged 5 and over speak a language other than English at home, 90.9% of them Samoan; no source names the language of screen work itself.

value.basis: census language at home, not a statement on film

sources.said: Among the household population 5 years and over, 96.7% spoke a language other than English at home. Of those who spoke a language other than English, 45.4% spoke English “very well” and 90.9% spoke Samoan.

figures.finding: The territory's seat of government is Fagatogo (Pago Pago harbour, Tutuila); no source measuring where screen work is made was found.

value.basis: seat of government, not a production count

sources.said: Section 9. Seat of government. The seat of Government shall be at Fagatogo.
